trial_type.Description: hfo_snippet: snippet centred on a detected HFO; background_snippet: snippet of background (non-HFO) activity

sample.Description: First sample of the snippet in the concatenated BrainVision file (0-based)

snippet.Description: Snippet number in the release (cell index of data.filtdata / data.rmsdata, 1-based)

hfo_index.Description: hfoI: 1-based index of this HFO in PatientInfo.HFO of the release

hfo_startTime.Description: PatientInfo.HFO.startTime as released (relative time; units not stated in the release)

hfo_stopTime.Description: PatientInfo.HFO.stopTime as released (relative time; units not stated in the release)

hfo_stdChanI.Description: PatientInfo.HFO.stdChanI: position (1-based) of the channel on which the HFO was detected, in the channel order of this file

hfo_stdChanIdx.Description: PatientInfo.HFO.stdChanIdx: standard channel index of the detection channel

hfo_sleepStage.Description: PatientInfo.HFO.sleepStage as released (coding not stated in the release)

hfo_ictalState.Description: PatientInfo.HFO.ictalState as released (coding not stated in the release)
